reviews.text: A friend recommended the Wolf Pool, and the service was fantastic. The pool was very clean compared to most other rooftop bars. We were taken care of by Annalee, and she absolutely killed it. Anything we needed, she handled and then some. We will definitely be returning based on the amazing service Annalee gave us.
reviews.author: Andy Tucker

reviews.text: A really mellow roof top dinner spot!! Make sure you get a reservation ahead of time. Everything we ordered was great! Unfortunately don’t have many pictures of our meals because we dug straight in. Oops! Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to.
reviews.author: Bailey Bollwinkel

reviews.text: This pool was beautiful on the top of the hotel! Comfortable tanning chairs, huge towels, a bar for service!
reviews.author: Emily Rutherford

reviews.text: Atmosphere is nice. Food is more like fancy fast food than a fine dining. Maybe the location makes them overpriced
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.text: The Salmon Caesar & the honey cake was great!  Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Andre Phinnessee

reviews.text: A great place to meet people, bring your friends or hang out, and watch the sunset. The food was very good.
reviews.author: Bernie

reviews.text: I was Staying at the Caesar Republic so I decided to check out Seven for a quick meal. The vibe was perfect and the customer service was outstanding and I was able to enjoy a great sunset view with my tasty sushi bombs and sweet potato tater tots.
reviews.author: Nichole Nichole

reviews.text:
Great food with amazing service. Really good cocktails. The menu is well thought out & delicious. The views are breath taking.

Exceptionally loud dining room.

I feel like Seven hasn't decided if it wants to be a rock concert venue or a restaurant?

The band was so loud we skipped desert b/c we were tired of yelling at each other over the music.

Definitely go on a night that does not have live music & you'll have a great experience.
reviews.author: Frank Buchanan

reviews.text: This place is underrated! This is a great happy hour spot! Request Joey or Julia as your server. They are the best! Food and drinks were amazing! We would definitely come back.
reviews.author: Marcus Mitchell

reviews.text: The food was great!!! Our waiter Skyler provided such amazing service!!! He was so welcoming and friendly.  We would definitely come back here again for the great food and awesome service.
reviews.author: Navin Seebaran

reviews.text:
We waited approximately 15 minutes before a server approached our table. Unfortunately, the experience went downhill from there. My date’s first cocktail arrived with a small fly in the glass. A busser noticed and kindly offered to have it remade. Since the bar was closing, my date also ordered a second drink at that time.

The bartender returned with what appeared to be the replacement drink and, while asking if my date wanted more water, proceeded to pour ice water directly into the cocktail glass—the same one that previously contained the fly. My date and I were both confused, and the bartender didn’t seem to understand our concern.

Shortly after, we also found a hair in my date’s food while the server was still standing at the table. Despite these issues, we were charged full price—including for the second drink, which never arrived.

To be clear, the food itself was delicious and the ambiance was outstanding. However, the service left much to be desired, especially considering it was a slow Monday evening. We expected a much more attentive and professional dining experience.
reviews.author: Khrystall Casey

reviews.text: Really loud inside, if you want to talk to your group at the table, forget it.  It rained, so our outside reservation got moved inside.  Service was OK.  Bar staff was great.
reviews.author: Diane Haywood

reviews.text: Do NOT go here for a holiday lunch. I visited Seven with my family for Mother's Day lunch and it was pretty horrible. For the price of the lunch for a special occasion, our entire party was very disappointed. The only great thing about our meal was the view. The buffet lunch was boring, overheated, had few options, and we were all worried we might get food poisoning from the seafood. There were hardly any special options. The crab legs weren’t cut enough to actually get any meat out of them so those were all wasted as we couldn’t actually open them, the oysters were flat and scrawny, the mussels all looked dried out. I went to the omelette station where their menu on the table stated they had egg whites which I was told they didn’t have when I tried to order them. There was basically an egg/waffle station, a salmon/prime rib station, a dessert counter with unappealing and few selections, and a main buffet with options you could get at a motel for the most part. They offered free mimosas for moms. We were sat at our table and left to figure out what to do next, no explanation until our server came over. We couldn’t get out of there fast enough which was very sad as it was supposed to be a special day and a special meal and the whole thing was disappointing. If this is an example of what kind of food they offer there, I wouldn’t recommend it as a restaurant either, we won’t be going back. The staff was also pretty unfriendly. Utter fail for a special day.
reviews.author: Jodi Kaye

reviews.text: Was at the pool for 3 hours celebrating my 1 year anniversary with my girlfriend. They had a pool waitress who didn’t even ask how we doing or check on us the whole 3 hours. When we wanted food/drinks we went inside to order. Got the tacos and they were cold and bland, didn’t get a thank you from the bartender either. You’d think paying $300 a night for a room you’d get good service. But i guess because i look young they could care less, terrible service i’ll never be back, just awful. Never been disrespected like this before, will tell my colleagues to not come here.
reviews.author: Kody Newman

reviews.text: The restaurant was pretty spectacular.  We wanted to sit on the patio, but it rained.  It was really loud inside, which is why we only gave it three stars, could not talk without yelling.  Live band did not help.  Food was good, pretty limited menu.  Bar and drinks were excellent.
reviews.author: Alan Haywood

reviews.text: Beautiful views!  The service was good as expected.  The food was good but not amazing - I think it was the sauces on the different meals we had.  Some places try too hard to set themselves apart with their own fancy sauces and it was a bit of a letdown.  The fish and chips had cornbread-like breading so if you like a little sweet it may be your thing along with the spicy tartar sauce.  Just give me regular tartar and old fashioned fish.  The salads were great.  The green salsa was sweet too.  Not my thing.
reviews.author: Justin Hall

reviews.text: Great staff, food, and scenery.
reviews.author: Nnedi Christian

reviews.text: The drinks were good. Didn't think the service or food was that great. I asked if I should order the black truffle steak frites or the ribs. Blonde manager suggested the steak frites, so I ordered Medium Rare. Some bites came out Medium Rare, others Medium and some rare. The blonde manager asked if I needed anything else and I said ketchup. Never came. Then I asked the bartender for ketchup. He didn't quality check my food, nor get me the ketchup. He just kept making drinks. I mentioned it to the guy sitting next to me, and he ordered the bar back to finally get me ketchup. It had been 20 minutes since I last asked for it. Who would spend this much money on crappy service when there are so many great restaurants in Scottsdale. This is my first time in Scottsdale and I would suggest to go elsewhere for food.
reviews.author: Lydia Guerrero

reviews.text: Thanks to our gracious Sarah. We had a very nice evening. Everyone else totally ignored us. Such a shame. Customer service should always be a priority. Use Sarah as a great example of 5 star service. Thank you Sarah, your the best!
reviews.author: Wynette Jones

reviews.text: Food was exquisite and service was top notch 👌
reviews.author: Vanessa Amaya

reviews.text: We came here to celebrate Valentine's day, and we ordered the salmon and steak frites. The steak frites was not that good, however the salmon was amazing, hence the two stars. For my steak, I wasn't given a steak knife. One of the manager saw that, and gave me one. What's worse is they charge you a credit card fee of 3.5% if you don't pay cash. I wish I knew this beforehand, I would have cancel my reservation.
reviews.author: btrix lim

reviews.text: I have a dietary restriction and am vegan, typically at nice restaurants this is not an issue because their kitchen can put something together. Either the server was unable to communicate with the kitchen or the kitchen was not able to put something simple together but my options were hummus or a salad…. To top it off the wait staff was very slow. I typically am not this hard on places but for this price point it should be excellent. And this was sub par experience at best.
reviews.author: Alexandra Schuessler

reviews.text:
Very pretty venue, atmosphere!
Service was 100% on-point, stunning view(s) of the sunset, and very enjoyable musician to listen to.  I will definitely go again.
reviews.author: Lori Feist

reviews.text: Peter and Madison were incredible! 10/10 would recommend! The bar was slammed during the SuperBowl and the two of them still managed to provide stellar service! Best bartenders in town!
reviews.author: Nathaniel Burk

reviews.text: This place is incredible. Amazing views, cool vibe, good food and the service we got from Jasmine was unmatched. She was so good, probably the best service I've ever had at a restaurant. Thank you Jasmine
reviews.author: Dan Bitcon

reviews.text: Terrible service way over.  Waited 20 min for a drink, twice!
reviews.author: Haim L

reviews.text: Was in town for a hospitality conference. Our group stayed here. The staff was welcoming and attentive. There are areas of improvement; understanding parking and where to park. The hotel allotted parking area is at the very bottom of the mall parking next door. It is confusing and hard to find without help. The stairwell to reach it is open to any level and is frankly creepy and feels unsafe if you are alone. There are three restaurants that are not all open at the same time, and you can wander looking for them if you are tired and  miss the map tucked over by the elevators. Being shown at check-in would be helpful. My shower took 5 minutes to warm up (I timed it), such as a waste of water. My colleague's door had lock issues, with multiple keys issued and a clicking that kept her awake all night. The room was beautiful and full of gadgets, a glass shower looking into the bedroom, which had an electric shade, an electric shade for the big picture window looking outside. It took several minutes to discover which switches turned on which light (wandering the room in the dark when first checking in) still didn't find all of them. A display of top shelf booze, mad it feel more like Vegas than Arizona. Overall, the stay was enjoyable but could have been extraordinary.
reviews.author: Christl Colven

reviews.text: Servicio rápido
reviews.author: Traderport

reviews.text: Pete was an absolute legend. His expertise and friendliness was par none. I plan to come back repeatedly just to enjoy his service again. I’m on a visit from Australia and I was blown away by his welcoming hospitable spirit.
reviews.author: David Rosenberg

reviews.text:
Cesars Republic is not only one of Scottsdale newest hotels but it's also Caesars' first non-gaming hotel. Now,  I haven't stayed here or even tried Giada's well known restaurant or cafe, but we went to the bar!

Seven is the pool lounge/restaurant located on the seventh floor. They have a fairly full menu ofl cocktails, apps, salads, sides and entrees. The bar sits between the restaurant and the open deck of the pool so it has both a fine dining feel and a casual feel with guests in sits but also guests walking around in bikinis.

The drinks are fun, but the views are gorgeous! This is the reason to go. You overlook Scottsdale with panoramic views of Camelback. It makes for perfect instagram pics and a great little date stop, especially at sunset.
reviews.author: msbusyblonde

reviews.text: We went to Seven mainly because I read that they serve house-made potato chips, which I’ll go anywhere for.  I was also under the impression that this is mostly a bar.  So we were pleasantly surprised to find a full menu of shareables, salads, mains, desserts, and excellent dinner service.  We started with the chips, even before the drinks (which we never do), which come with the charred onion dip.  They were good but I suggest making them a little thinner.  The dip was excellent, so we kept the extra to use with our mains.  The braised short ribs with mashed potatoes were excellent, as was the grapefruit-glazed salmon with cauliflower purée.   I especially liked the crispy skin, which was served as the presentation side.  They had a good selection of reasonably priced wines, which we always appreciate. The honey cake and multi-layer chocolate cake were great finales.  The restaurant itself is sprawling and spacious and dimly lit.  It’s a great place to go with a group, but we were also comfortable as a four-top.  I’ve heard there is a great view along the west side before dark, but we also enjoyed the view after dark.  YouTube’s Chef’s Apprentice
reviews.author: John Hornick Chef’s Apprentice

reviews.text: Can we take a minute to talk about Peter???? LITERALLY TEN OUT OF TEN SERVICE. We had to much fun enjoying all of his cocktails and service. The espresso martini and signature shots he made us were fantastic. Thank you for an amazing late night!
reviews.author: Jillian Graham

reviews.text: They made our Anniversary special & more importantly, they made me presenting my fiancé, his forever ring very memorable. Our server Natalie was AMAZING! GM came by a few times to check in on us. Great food, great service, absolutely incredible views.
reviews.author: G Na

reviews.text: Had an absolute blast here. Cocktails and appetizers were great. Service was fast and very friendly. Ask for Pete to be your bartender and i promise he wont disappoint.
reviews.author: Jack Young

reviews.text:
Highly recommend this rooftop dining experience at all times of the day and year!  During the afternoon, you can have a more casual experience by the pool while at night you can enjoy an upscale vibe with fire pits, couches, and great live music.  The views of Camelback Mountain were extremely memorable, especially during sunset at their second floor lounge area.  Best experience was coming here for a Sunday football afternoon with plenty of huge TVs streaming every game you can imagine.

Would most definitely recommend requesting Peter as your bartender.  Not only does he make a great drink, but as a couple in Scottsdale on vacation, he provided us with our favorite recommendations of the trip from dinners to adventures and shopping.
reviews.author: Marina Moceri

reviews.text: A Sky-High Dining Experience. Located on the 7th floor of the Caesars Republic, S7ven offers a breathtaking dining experience with phenomenal views of the city. The atmosphere is electric, with a sophisticated and stylish vibe. The perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal and soak in the stunning scenery.
reviews.author: Damian S

reviews.text: Amazing food, drinks and views!
reviews.author: Isis Bluu

reviews.text: Wonderful ambiance, courteous staff, and delicious cocktails and food. Highly recommend the poke nachos!
reviews.author: Monique Johnson

reviews.text: Exceeded my expectations.  Will return for dinner.
reviews.author: R M

reviews.text: Marshamallow Espresso Martini , delicious 🤤
reviews.author: Jujuba Verde

reviews.text: Awesome place and friendly staff... except that we both woke up in the middle of the night vomiting after we ate dinner here. 🙃
reviews.author: Justin Tilley

reviews.text: Bright and airy with beautiful views. Service was friendly. Everyone that touched our table was smiling and our server had great suggestions. We were the only table in the restaurant, but she was around the perfect amount. Appetizers and entrees had great timing and everything was delicious. I gave 4 stars only because the protein selections were a little dry. Other than that, everything was great! I would definitely return for another visit.
reviews.author: K I

reviews.text: The atmosphere was something I had not experienced before. Being on the 7th floor you get a beautiful view anywhere you sit. I ordered the Classic Wagyu Burger well done and it came out as expected and tasted great.
reviews.author: Seth Syverson

reviews.text: This restaurant has beautiful views of Camelback Mountain. The food was tasty and well presented. I also tried one of the smoothies which was refreshing! I will definitely be visiting this place again.
reviews.author: K O

reviews.text: Amazing service! And views are so pretty. Joey was so great and attentive.
reviews.author: Dezi Garza

reviews.text: Stopped for a happy hour drink and loved the view!
reviews.author: Maria Terese

reviews.text: Came here for the first time, for mine and my fiancé’s one year anniversary. It was our first restaurant we went to that day and it did not disappoint. The staff was welcoming and kind. Our waiter was informative and attentive. The food was amazing! I had the braised short rib. My fiancé had the wagyu burger. I recommend both dishes! They made our celebration feel special and gave us a complimentary dessert. We will definitely be back! The view is also really nice might I add. And the atmosphere is lively!
reviews.author: C C

reviews.text: I had high hopes for this place, but it fell short of my expectations. The environment felt stale, and there were too many TVs, giving off an odd sports bar vibe. The space was awkward, and the chairs were difficult to move, with the rubber arms constantly getting stuck on the floor, making it a struggle for everyone to scoot or get up. The service was disappointing; our waitress was rude and seemed to avoid us. It took over an hour for our food to arrive, and she never checked in to update us. The Wagyu burger was decent, but the menu lacked variety, offering mostly basic options. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this spot unless you're looking for a quick, simple meal without leaving the hotel.
reviews.author: Ciarra Jarosch-Bolte

reviews.text: Zeta was so great!
reviews.author: Marcella Alvarez

reviews.text: Came in for golden hour with some girlfriends and loved the atmosphere. The view was breath taking. Spectacular service and delicious cocktails. Avery was amazing, definitely would recommend and come back just because of him!!!!
reviews.author: Super Fredbear's Gaming Channel

reviews.text: Avery is amazing!! Top notch service and food knowledge!! Will be back because of him!!
reviews.author: PennyLane

reviews.text: Fantastic food, cocktails, and especially wonderful service!!!!
reviews.author: Scott Eddy

reviews.text: The most underrated in Scottsdale, now.
reviews.author: Utku Akabay

reviews.text: Some of the best bartenders and servers in town!
reviews.author: Zach Moore

reviews.text:
Second visit to Seven. First time was wonderful. Last night, unbelievably bad.
Server was possibly overwhelmed but not attentive or even competent. Would take one drink order & walk away leaving other guests waiting for 15 minutes to place their drink order.

One person in our party wanted a light dinner bc we were dining at 8pm. Server said he’d get from downstairs restaurant, no problem. GM delivered shrimp cocktail by dropping paper to go bag on the table and insisted the hues couldn’t have it served and wouldn’t provide a plate and cutlery. A simple no we don’t have shrimp
Cocktail or communication that it was prohibited would have been great. $11 per shrimp, 4 ordered and then advised not to be eaten in Seven.

Umami chicken which I had before and loved was so over cooked - the knife provided wouldn’t cut. They remade and second was also overcooked.

The music was too loud to converse, the server was way over his head and also told he couldn’t transfer to work at Luna, the food wasn’t prepared properly, the shrimp debacle, waiting 15 minutes just to Order a drink AFTER the server took my friend’s order and abruptly walked away (we were ordering the same drinks btw but he left before we could say make it 2), the attitude and attire of the unprofessional GM, and the whole experience make me wish I could give a zero.

GM needs training- or maybe an off night but last night she had zero business in the hospitality industry.
Another manager was friendly & tried to be helpful.
Bussers were fast & courteous.
First experience was great but Saturday night at 8pm was awful!
reviews.author: kelly saindon

reviews.text: One of the best views of Camelback Mountain during sunset. The atmosphere has a relaxed, uplifting social vibe, open floor with lots of seating. The drinks and food were amazing. The combination of flavors are very tasty. Our realtor Scott Bryant, from Bryant Luxury Group, and his team introduced us to this magnificent restaurant and lounge as part of their event they hosted for their clients. I recommend this place for a beautiful date night with your significant others or a group of close friends. SEVEN is a must visit place! We will be going back.
reviews.author: Florentino Bandin-Esparza

reviews.text:
Highly recommend reserving in advance as we were able to get the best spot in the entire restaurant for outdoor views/vibes. the sweet heat wings were one of the best wings ive ever had, and im definitely trying garlic parm next time.

nate was awesome and offered to take some amazing pics of us.

jasmine was also attentive and gave some very nice food recs
reviews.author: Sunny Vakkalanka

reviews.text:
Madison was an amazing bartender and Olivia followed up with our group who was the manager very hospitable and sweet thank you very much!!

Nate and Sam
reviews.author: nate a

reviews.text: Was very excited to check this place out but it was unfortunately overrated and a bad experience. The view was kind of cool but not spectacular. Mezcal cocktail was pretty good, but the rest of the drinks and food were just okay. Customer service was shockingly bad when something went wrong - our waiter made a mistake with our order, didn't attempt to make it right, and then the manager was rude and dismissive when we brought it to her attention. There are much better places to go in the area if you want a nice dinner.
reviews.author: Alex Swartz

reviews.text:
Beautiful space & view, great service but don't order the gnocchi. Small small portion. Hamburger very good. Chicken salad average.
Ordered a great Manhattan on the rocks - charged $4.00 for ICE!
Parking not too easy.
reviews.author: Kristi King

reviews.text: Cocktails are a little on the pricey side, but they are delicious. The views of the mountains are perfect and it’s right by the Hotels pool. Went for happy hour with a large group of people and we got one of every appetizer. They were so good.
reviews.author: Taylor Moon

reviews.text: Our Bartender Aerley was AMAZING. She gave us outstanding service and was very knowledgeable about the menu. Loved her!!!
reviews.author: Alyssa Adams

reviews.text: I really recommend  to check this place  out, you'll love it!!
reviews.author: Tibu Aguirre

reviews.text: Fabulous view, great food, and friendly, attentive staff!
reviews.author: Liz B

reviews.text: We absolutely love Seven @ Ceasars Republic.  We absolutely love taking out of town guest there
reviews.author: Tricia Lehane

reviews.text: Seven offers impeccable service that anticipates your every need with an ambiance that exudes sophistication. It's a sanctuary of refined taste and wonderful scenic views.
reviews.author: Jennifer Lloyd

reviews.text: The rooftop views are spectacular.  Service was very good. Ordered happy hour food and drinks. Only the drinks got happy hour pricing unfortunately told too bad so sad about that. Management needs to reconsider.
reviews.author: Sammy Zawatski

reviews.text:
Great atmosphere, great service.
Our hostess, Julia, was amazing. She hosted our party of 13 marvelously.
The security details were very friendly.
Seven was such a great experience.
Thanks guys!
reviews.author: Eric Peck

reviews.text:
My wife and I stopped in to have drinks while waiting for a restaurant downstairs to open, so we didn't eat food. We ordered first drinks and walked them over to a window to enjoy the view; my wife's purse was still at our seats. They took this opportunity to clean-up our water glasses.

It took some time to get attention to put a second drink order in. When I ordered my drink (Blantons neat), I admit that I didn't think to ask for a price. I've ordered this drink more times in my life than I can possibly count, and it is a higher-end bourbon, but I've never paid more than $26 for this order. Imagine my surprise when I got the bill and saw that they had charged me $60 for this one drink! Absolutely ludicrous. We were in a hurry to leave so I didn't argue; the receipt clearly said "1 Blantons" so it wasn't as if they had mistakenly incremented the quantity, and the price is fixed in the system so what would have been the point?

I decided that this review would be my complaint. I've also told my bourbon-favoring friends that if you go there and don't want to drink a bourbon that you can buy at the supermarket, you better be prepared to pay at least $60.
reviews.author: John Paglia

reviews.text: Now we tried the sliders - dont waste your money on them. I'd compare the sliders to McDonald's as they taste the same just with fresher pickles. The MEATBALL is amazing, it rests on this whipped ricotta bed and tastes so fresh. Drinks are a little pricy even for scottsdale- pricy pricy. The view of camelback over sunset was perfect and our server was great with all our questions
reviews.author: Emily Tynis

reviews.text: The food was very good. The view was amazing, but windows where everyone is focused were very dirty in a large area. Staff was friendly, but for the caliber of restaurant, it felt a bit like we were in Twin Peaks the way the staff was dressed. Bras a must. One waitress was bouncing all around as she walked. It was very unprofessional. Time for a staff meeting.
reviews.author: Kimberley S

reviews.text:
Where do I start? I made a reservation on OpenTable. We waited almost 15 minutes after we were seated before someone came to the table and it wasn’t a server. It was a manager asking us if we’ve been waited on…..

We ordered a bottle of wine from the manager which took another 15 minutes to get. We also ordered an appetizer which didn’t arrive until five minutes before our entrees arrived. The manager brought out the appetizer said that he would comp the appetizer because it was so delayed. After being seated for 25 minutes, we received water.  It was just one bad service situation after another.  Here’s what I don’t  understand… There were two managers on the floor who did nothing but look at their phones.  The staff seem to be so uninformed. When an actual waiter did hit our table, he came up and said what would we would like to order this evening. I asked him what is your name ?  He said oh sorry I forgot to introduce myself.

This is the second time I have been to this restaurant and the first time was a similar experience. We did order the spinach dip appetizer, which was quite good. We ordered the short ribs and salmon dish. The short ribs were overcooked but the salmon was prepared well.

The views are beautiful. So are the views of  other rooftop restaurants in Scottsdale, where the food and  service is above and beyond and at the same price point.

The frosting on the cake was when I received an email from OpenTable telling me that I was a no-show. So I guess they couldn’t even get that right……
reviews.author: Susan Frasca

reviews.text: This place tonight for Mother’s Day smh, y’all should be ashamed of the service you provided tonight. Slow as molasses, food mediocre and took forever to come out. And all you offered is a free dessert lol. Not even the manager come to our table. No wonder this place is mostly empty. Too add manager finally came to our table 😒
reviews.author: Jasmine Cummings

reviews.text: Service sucks .  20 minutes to get our first drink another 30 minutes to get a hummus appetizer. That’s when we decided that we were done. I highly recommend not coming here.
reviews.author: Trevor Skoro

reviews.text: We had a fantastic girls night here! The views were incredible and the open air was wonderful. The cocktails were expensive but delicious. All of the food we had was wonderful - expensive, but worth it. The pretzel was one of the best soft pretzels I have ever had. All around the service was wonderful as well.
reviews.author: Emily A

reviews.text: Unsanitary waiter was scratching his nose and busy cleaning the floor for an hour. Then he picked up the dirty rag and handed us our menus. We should have left. The food was awful too. What a joke of a so-called restaurant. The hostess may think about wearing some clothing and trying to stay awake.
reviews.author: Myra Richman

reviews.text: Dinner and drinks were to die for and the service from Danielle was AMAZING!
reviews.author: Alex Miles

reviews.text: Solid food. Incredible room and views. Terrible unprofessional service at the bar.
reviews.author: Scott Cathcart

reviews.text: Food was cold, bland, not flavorful, and not good.  My coffee was stale and cold. The service was slow and the food took along time.
reviews.author: Melissa A

reviews.text: Mmmm.... Whaa??    No WiFi? Up in Seven the Bar ??  Guess you all 'r paying for the View!
reviews.author: Antal Toth

reviews.text: The views of Camelback Mountain, especially at sunset are spectacular. Even though the menu is limited the food was excellent. Our server Zach was pleasant, attentive and very friendly. We had a 5 star experience on 3 different occasions. I highly recommend this restaurant.
reviews.author: Rick Kahler

reviews.text: Cannot say enough about how amazing this place is! Good drinks , good views, and great service. Zach took such great care of us with the best recommendations! Amazing espresso martinis and spinach dip!
reviews.author: Karissa Millar

reviews.text: The views here were immaculate! Our server Zach was amazing and took care of our every need while providing a great experience! The espresso martinis were awesome as well!
reviews.author: Mack Schroeder

reviews.text: Views are awesome, food is a bit pricey for the quantity.  What do you expect it is Scottsdale and then they add a service fee added. I'm not sure what that is but just be aware...
reviews.author: APARTMENT OPTIONS

reviews.text:
Not a fan of this new spot, the decor inside reminds me of a corporate cafeteria, there are a couple of nice fire tables by the pool area but otherwise not a great seat in this restaurant.

The service was just ok, and they put blue cheese stuffed olives covered in oil in my martini

Nothing special about this spot, Not worth the money
reviews.author: Kelly Peters

reviews.text: Gorgeous spot with great views.  Service started shaky but came around very quickly.  I believe this place will settle in and become another regular spot for me.
reviews.author: Brian Reeves

reviews.text: Came to celebrate a birthday, party of 10. Drinks were good, short rib and puree were cold, the chicken was dry, and they had to remake another entree. Also be aware they will charge you a 20% large party fee that we were not aware of. Views are great but definitely not coming back for cold overpriced food.
reviews.author: Kim O

reviews.text: First time at Seven and it exceeded our expectations. Jasmine our server was awesome and took great care of us!  She was kind, attentive and thorough and our food came out perfect and timely.  The appetizers were awesome. We started with the hummus plate which was huge, the pretzel was warm and delicious and the carne asada tacos were fantastic. At this point we were full but we could not leave without trying the Wagyu Burger, which did not disappoint!   Cocktails were pretty and tasty.  We had the pleasure of meeting the GM, Eric who was friendly, sharp and awesome.  What a great place with a spectacular view and a great bar!
reviews.author: Nancy C

reviews.text: I have been to Seven twice since they opened and had a fantastic experience both times. The atmosphere is very modern and minimalistic with incredible views of Camelback mountain. Danielle was our server and she was very accommodating and gave us great recommendations. We had incredible service, food, and drinks in a great atmosphere. I’m so happy this place opened up right by me. Definitely recommend
reviews.author: danhomaijani

reviews.text:
Food was good, drinks were good. Restaurant was a little loud- hard to have a conversation, but at least the music was good.
Avery our waiter was amazing.
reviews.author: Faydra Huntingford

reviews.text: Zach was a great server and really enjoyed the burger and nice to have a local place you can slip into
reviews.author: Lincoln Trust

reviews.text: Our server Zach was awesome and this place has a wonderful view of the mountain. Wagyu burger and the chicken melt were really good.
reviews.author: A Laub

reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at Seven. Our bartender Lauren was friendly, attentive, and made us fantastic drinks. Her knowledge of the cocktails and willingness to offer recommendations made for a great experience. I will definitely be back to enjoy their service again!
reviews.author: Victoria Mendoza

reviews.text: I couldn’t rave enough about how truly great this place is! The entire menu is amazing from the appetizers & entree’s to the deserts. The Grape Fruit Glazed Salmon was the best Salmon I’ve ever had! The atmosphere and view was amazing as well I enjoyed my food while watching the sunset over Scottsdale and WOW was it beautiful! The only thing better than the food & atmosphere were the drinks. They were so good I had to try several and the bartender who served me Lauren was so sweet and made the best margarita I’ve ever had! I say proudly that SEVEN is now hands down one of my favorite places to eat & grab a drink. Thank you so much to the chef & to Lauren for making the experience so memorable! I can’t wait to return for another meal and of course another margarita!!
reviews.author: Chris Weaver

reviews.text: Zack our server was amazing. Professional and kind.
reviews.author: MARIA CECILIA MALUFF-VENTURA

reviews.text: Zack was great!
reviews.author: Dawn Quadrini

reviews.text: Food is fine but wish there were more options especially brunch.  With the nice views and a brunch option would be amazing
reviews.author: Nirali Bavda

reviews.text: The views were immaculate! I ordered the 'herb-infused chicken melt,' and the sandwich was more impressive tasting than I thought it would be. Probably still working out some service quirks because it's a new joint, but happy with the experience and am looking forward to making my next reservation there.
reviews.author: Connor Kenrick

reviews.text: Love this spot! Some of the best rooftop views in Scottsdale! Drinks are spectacular and the food was amazing. Great vibes and ambience and they even had a rooftop pool deck. Highly recommend checking this place out!
reviews.author: Alex Walker

reviews.text: Zach was wonderful. You are fortunate to have him on your team.
reviews.author: Jeannie Watts

reviews.text: This was an absolutely AMAZING experience! First of all, the elevated view was flawless as we arrived around sunset. It really set a certain vibe! The food was Great! I tried everything as well as the desserts. The service was also impeccable!! Danielle had the perfect personality and made sure we had what we needed at all times!! Experiencing Seven is a must!!
reviews.author: HIRO RAP

reviews.text: Friends and I came in to see the new property. Went up to Seven to have some drinks. Zach took care of us. He did an amazing job on recommending drinks and was very friendly and personable.
reviews.author: Alfred Miller

reviews.text: Ari our server and the manager DeVaughn were both superlative! I was nervous and hesitant, but they exceeded my expectations.  I will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Chef Markus Ford (Markus)

reviews.text: Annalee was fantastic! Took great care of our party
reviews.author: Matt ploger

reviews.text: A much needed addition to Scottsdale! Come see Davaughn and Annalee, they will take care of you!
reviews.author: Karam Moon, MD

reviews.text: This place is amazing, great views great food. The drinks were very good and the attention to detail was incredible. Also the staff are very friendly and make it enjoyable experience. Will be coming here frequently.
reviews.author: tyler smyth

reviews.text: Everything about this place is great. From the food to the drinks, to the staff, to the view. I recommend catching a sunset here with a cocktail or dinner. Unbeatable views.
reviews.author: D H

reviews.text: Views are unbeatable, the short rib and salmon are my favorites and you have to get the cheesecake and espresso martini for dessert
reviews.author: Makenzie Gossage

reviews.text: My experience at Seven was amazing! The food was amazing and the customer service of all the restaurants employees was very inviting. My server Danielle had a great personality, very outgoing and also had a smile on her face! The ladies at the hostess stand were professional and also had an outstanding personality!
reviews.author: Romi da Homie

reviews.text: We had an amazing family dinner, thanks to Danielle. She was very attentive. Never had empty drinks, always had a smile on her face and a great personality. Service and food were great.
reviews.author: Cassidy Cohen

reviews.text: A wonderful new addition to Old Town area. Especially to entertain visiting guests. Great view. The food was excellent and our server, Danielle, was very pleasant yet efficient. Only thing id change is the volume of the music. Hard to carry on a conversation.
reviews.author: John Venners

reviews.text: Alex was great.
reviews.author: June Nero

reviews.text: The views and atmosphere are like no other. Between the quality of their food and drinks along with the great service from the entire staff, this place is a must see of you are in Arizona!
reviews.author: Francesco Scalise

reviews.text: Great new hot spot.  Lucky to be there opening night.  Great vibe in a great space.  Absolutely stunning views.  Service was excellent  - friendly and frequent.  Never needed to motion for a server or busser.  Food was very  good. Kind of an elevated gastro pub.  Unique cocktail menu, but a fully stocked bar if you want your traditional drinks. Big bar with seating, and various outdoor spots for drinks. DJ/music, so it's not a quiet romantic spot, but will be a hit for those who want to be seen and be a part of the scene.
reviews.author: Dan I

reviews.text: Seven is the BEST! What a view and the food was incredible. All three of us had something different and each was delicious. We were impressed with the amazing cocktail options and wine selection. This is definitely the place to go to impress or be impressed!
reviews.author: Lissa Druss

reviews.text: Amazing view! Food and service was spot on. Will be back.
reviews.author: Justen Siegler

reviews.text: Attended the grand opening of SEVEN and was blown away! The atmosphere is super cool, complete with a pool that adds a unique touch and incredible views of the mountains. The cocktails and food were amazing, making it a perfect spot for a night out. Definitely recommend checking it out
reviews.author: Andriana Nativio

reviews.text: New favorite bar in Scottsdale! Great view, decent drink list, fantastic vibe. The marshmallow espresso martini is a big hit and this place is on its way to be the place to be in old town.
reviews.author: Gregory Puckett

reviews.text:
Avery was outstanding! Very attentive and kind to us.

We tried the hummus and chopped salad which came out promptly!

The hummus was flavorful and colorful.
The salad was crisp!

Views outstanding.
We will be back.
reviews.author: Jaclyn Humphry

reviews.text: Avery was fantastic! Will be coming back again!
reviews.author: Lily Rosenbalm
